newsitem.title: UK: British-Borneo buys Gulf Mexico oil blocks.
newsitem.headline: British-Borneo buys Gulf Mexico oil blocks.

text.p: British-Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc said on Tuesday that one of its subsidiaries, British-Borneo Petroleum Inc (BBPI), would buy three oil blocks off Louisiana from Shell Deepwater Development Inc.
The UK firm named the three blocks as Blocks Mississippi Canyon 502, 503 and 546 in the Gulf of Mexico.
BBPI would acquire and interpret 3D seismic data over the blocks during the first half of 1997 with an option to drill a well by mid-1998, it said in a statement.
Under the terms of agreement, BBPI would assume full working interest in the blocks.
Shell would retain an overriding royalty, which converts to a sharing of net profit after a certain quantity of oil and gas has been produced.
